assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The service is to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes
The service was rendered on the service date
The service requires the precertification or authorization (CO-197)
The precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service
